text:
sam (platform): quick follow-up from the postmortem: recurring ramp windows keep eating p99 error budget. proposing a different model: per-customer burst credits + SLO tiers (steady vs ramp). want owners for rollout and dashboard changes.

ria (infra): sounds good. can we detect ramps more reliably? i can export a 'ramp_index' metric based on node_join_rate + traffic_accel and tag events. i'll own infra detection + metric (ETA 24h).

colin (serving): serving suggestion: when ramp_index > threshold, enable burst credits for affected customer ids and switch routing to pre-warmed KV shards. also apply a soft batch_cap to reduce queueing. i'll own changes to the serving controller (ETA 72h).

hana (product): product concerns: if we change SLO semantics we need a clear opt-in flow and comms. customers should see explicit "burst credits" on the billing page. i'll write comms + opt-in UX (ETA 36h).

ops-bot: Incident LOG-2026-311: autoscaler ramp correlated with KV-cache misses.

sam (platform): draft SLO structure (conceptual):
```yaml
service: inference-api
slo:
  steady_state:
    p99_ms: 450
    window: 30d
  ramp_tier:
    enabled: true
    p95_rps: 160
    burst_credit: 3000  # requests per 10m per customer
    credit_window: 10m
error_budget_policy:
  allow_credit_draw: true
  max_credit_draw_pct: 0.03
annotations:
  note: "ramp_tier applies only when ramp_index > 0.7"
```
Goal: isolate expected ramp noise into a bounded "credit" that doesn't immediately burn steady-state latency budget.

ria (infra): i'll add ramp_index and export ramp_events with reason tags (autoscaler_backfill, region_failover). We'll also tag which customers were routed through fallback.

colin (serving): will add metrics: burst_credit_balance{customer_id}, prewarm_shard_hit_rate, batch_cap_applied. will also add two alerts: "burst_credit_balance < 10% for any enterprise customer for 5m" and "prewarm_shard_hit_rate < 80% for 10m". alert snippet: 
```
alert: LowBurstCreditBalance
expr: burst_credit_balance{customer_tier=\"enterprise\"} < 0.1
for: 5m
```

hana (product): action items & owners:
- hana (product): opt-in UX + billing note + comms draft (due 36h)
- ria (infra): ramp_index metric + event tags + dashboard panels (due 24h)
- colin (serving): pre-warm + batch_cap + credit accounting + alerts (due 72h)
- sam (platform): SLO config PR + decision meeting invite (due 12h)

sam (platform): opened PR placeholder: https://git.redwood/slo-config/pulls/999 - draft only. adding decision doc.

colin (serving): staging pre-warm flow shows 92% warm hit rate. canary scheduled in 8h, link to canary logs when up.

ria (infra): added ramp_event tag to logs and exported ramp_index. will create a dashboard heatmap for region ramp patterns.

hana (product): will prepare a short customer FAQ and propose a 30-day enterprise trial for burst credits. looping in legal.

sam (platform): scheduling a 4-day decision sync to assess telemetry and decide opt-in vs global rollout: https://cal.link/4day-burst-credits.

ops-bot: Reminder: postmortem follow-up checklist assigned to sam (platform).

sam (platform): final note: prefer bounded credits over temporary SLO relaxations. credits let us quantify cost and surface tradeoffs on billing dashboard. closing this thread for updates; please post PR/canary links here. :white_check_mark:
